text_blocks.snippet: In 2021, asthma affected an estimated 24.9 million people in the U.S., including 4.7 million children and 20.3 million adults, representing 7.7% of the population. Asthma prevalence varies across different demographics, with higher rates among certain racial and ethnic groups, and females. Poorly controlled asthma can significantly impact daily life, leading to missed school or work days and increased emergency room visits and hospitalizations.
